examples.english: Police have to follow very strict procedures when they arrest someone.
examples.persian: پلیس باید هنگام دستگیری فردی از رویه‌های بسیار دقیقی پیروی کند.

miniContext: Police have to follow very strict procedures when they arrest someone.

examples.english: An arrest is when a police constable detains someone suspected of an offence.
examples.persian: دستگیری زمانی است که یک افسر پلیس فردی مظنون به جرم را بازداشت می‌کند.

miniContext: An arrest is when a police constable detains someone suspected of an offence.

meaning: مظنون دانستن کسی به انجام کاری

examples.english: The police can detain someone if they suspect that this person has committed an offence.
examples.persian: پلیس می‌تواند فردی را بازداشت کند اگر مظنون باشد که او مرتکب جرمی شده است.

miniContext: The police can detain someone if they suspect that this person has committed an offence.

examples.english: The police charged him with several offences, including the illegal possession of a weapon.
examples.persian: پلیس او را به چند جرم از جمله نگهداری غیرقانونی سلاح متهم کرد.

miniContext: The police charged him with several offences, including the illegal possession of a weapon.

examples.english: The police can arrest you if they have a valid arrest warrant.
examples.persian: پلیس می‌تواند در صورت داشتن حکم بازداشت معتبر شما را دستگیر کند.

miniContext: The police can arrest you if they have a valid arrest warrant.

examples.english: A search warrant is a warrant to search someone's property.
examples.persian: حکم بازرسی حکمی است برای بازرسی اموال کسی.

miniContext: A search warrant is a warrant to search someone's property.

examples.english: Who issues an arrest warrant?
examples.persian: چه کسی حکم بازداشت را صادر می‌کند؟

miniContext: Who issues an arrest warrant?

examples.english: The man will now appear before a magistrate tomorrow morning.
examples.persian: آن مرد فردا صبح در برابر قاضی حاضر خواهد شد.

miniContext: The man will now appear before a magistrate tomorrow morning.

examples.english: The police have reasonable grounds for suspecting you have committed an offence.
examples.persian: پلیس دلایل منطقی برای مظنون دانستن شما به ارتکاب جرم دارد.

miniContext: The police have reasonable grounds for suspecting you have committed an offence.

examples.english: The police can arrest you if you are about to commit an offence.
examples.persian: اگر در شرف ارتکاب جرمی باشید، پلیس می‌تواند شما را دستگیر کند.

miniContext: The police can arrest you if you are about to commit an offence.

examples.english: You are cautioned and then taken to a police station as soon as possible.
examples.persian: به شما هشدار رسمی داده می‌شود و سپس در اسرع وقت به کلانتری برده می‌شوید.

miniContext: You are cautioned and then taken to a police station as soon as possible.

examples.english: Once you are in custody, you have the right to legal advice from a solicitor.
examples.persian: وقتی در بازداشت هستید، حق مشاوره‌ی حقوقی از یک وکیل را دارید.

miniContext: Once you are in custody, you have the right to legal advice from a solicitor.

examples.english: He refused his right to speak to a solicitor.
examples.persian: او از حق صحبت با وکیل خودداری کرد.

miniContext: He refused his right to speak to a solicitor.

examples.english: The police later charged him with several offences.
examples.persian: پلیس بعداً او را به چند جرم متهم کرد.

meaning: بازگرداندن به بازداشت تا زمان محاکمه

examples.english: A magistrate will decide whether you should be remanded in custody or released on bail.
examples.persian: قاضی تصمیم می‌گیرد که آیا شما باید در بازداشت بمانید یا با قید وثیقه آزاد شوید.

miniContext: A magistrate will decide whether you should be remanded in custody or released on bail.

examples.english: He hopes to be granted bail.

miniContext: He hopes to be granted bail.

examples.english: If he is convicted, he could be sentenced to a lengthy period in prison.

miniContext: If he is convicted, he could be sentenced to a lengthy period in prison.

examples.english: If your case goes to trial, you will either be convicted of the crime, or found innocent and acquitted.
examples.persian: اگر پرونده‌ی شما به محاکمه برسد، یا محکوم می‌شوید یا بی‌گناه شناخته و تبرئه می‌شوید.

examples.english: Above the rank of constable is the sergeant, and so on.
